title: One request, on the wire and through the broker
dek: A broker is two thread pools and one queue, and one rule, the muted socket, gives every connection one request at a time. This second part of a five-part teardown follows a request through Apache Kafka 4.4.0: a real 139-byte Produce decoded by hand, a batch that reaches the consumer changed only in a field the broker stamps, requests parked in purgatory holding no thread, a Produce born with its timeout error already set, the timing wheel underneath, quotas that answer first and go silent after, a protocol generated from 203 JSON files, and a Produce version the broker advertises and refuses on purpose.
byline: 6 November 2026 · Subject: kafka@1156b275 (Apache Kafka 4.4.0) · Part 2 of 5 · Read from the source; measured where this machine allows
description: Apache Kafka 4.4.0 taken apart, part 2: the broker's thread pools and request queue, the muted socket, a real Produce frame decoded byte by byte, purgatory and the timing wheel, quota throttling, generated protocol schemas, and ApiVersions negotiation.
og_description: Part 2 of a five-part Kafka teardown at 1156b275 (4.4.0): two thread pools and a queue, one in-flight request per connection, a real 139-byte Produce by hand, parked requests that hold no thread, a timeout that undoes nothing, timing wheels, answer-then-mute quotas, and Produce v0 advertised and refused on purpose. Timings are loopback through a Python proxy on a shared 2-vCPU box: relative only.
twitter_description: Apache Kafka 4.4.0 taken apart, part 2: one request on the wire and through the broker, with real bytes and honest labels.
badges_callout:
How to read the badges

from the code marks a fact read from the pinned sources, cited as repo/path:line: Apache Kafka 4.4.0 (1156b275), librdkafka v2.16.0 (c6c9973c) and franz-go (123ec885). Kafka paths start at kafka/, and a … inside a path elides src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/ or src/main/scala/kafka/. message/ abbreviates clients/src/main/resources/common/message/. measured here marks bytes or numbers observed on the research box: real Java 4.4.0 clients and hand-built frames against live brokers, through a logging Python proxy where frames were captured, all on loopback on a shared 2-vCPU machine. Timings there show relative behaviour, never capacity. Each scenario is a single run, and is called that where it matters. librdkafka was read, never run. Trunk was read, never built. reconstruction marks a judgement or a worked example drawn from those sources rather than read in one place.

This is Part 2 of 5 of Kafka, taken apart. Part 1 reads the log on disk; Part 3 covers what an ack promises, replication and the metadata quorum; Part 4 covers producers and consumer groups; Part 5 covers exactly-once, and ends with the findings register.
